meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加、修复、调整界面组件,快速搭建标准化的前端页面。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建网页界面,需要反复添加和调整现成的界面组件。
copy.tagline_en: Add, fix, and style UI components to streamline building frontend pages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build web interfaces and want to easily manage and adjust UI components.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会使用 shadcn CLI 与项目配置，帮你查找、添加、修 bug、改样式、组合 UI 组件，并强制按技能内置的代码规范输出（如用 gap、语义色，不手写轮子）。
howto.when: 当项目里有 components.json，或你提到 shadcn/ui、--preset、组件注册表等关键词，或说出“shadcn init”等指令时触发。

say.text: 给项目加一个 Dialog 组件
say.note: Claude 会先查项目配置，再用 CLI 添加。

say.text: 把设置页改成 Tabs 加 Card 的组合
say.note: 按组合规则重构，不新造样式。

say.text: 项目里 Select 没放进 SelectGroup，帮我修复
say.note: 会检查并修正组件结构。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude manages shadcn components and projects: it uses the official CLI and project config to search, add, fix, style and compose UI (including chat), following fixed rules like gap classes and semantic colors.
howto.when_en: Applies when the project has components.json, or when you mention shadcn/ui, component registries, or --preset codes, or say "shadcn init"-style commands.

say_en.text: Add a Dialog component to the project.
say_en.note: Claude inspects project config, then runs add.

say_en.text: Refactor the settings page as Tabs plus Card.
say_en.note: Applies composition rules, not custom styling.

say_en.text: Fix the Select that is not inside SelectGroup.
say_en.note: Checks and corrects the component structure.
